calls.statement:
SELECT
  f.vat_rate,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate DESC

SELECT
  f.vat_rate * 100 AS vat_rate_percent,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate DESC
